test_title: PYST 5: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate phrasal verb.

The elder child takes ________ his father. They look like siblings.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. after**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrasal verb **"takes after"** means to resemble a family member in appearance, behavior, or character. (किसी परिवार के सदस्य के समान दिखना या व्यवहार करना।) • **Example:** She takes after her mother in her love for music. • In the given sentence, **"takes after"** is used to indicate that the elder child resembles his father, implying that their appearance or behavior is similar. (यह दिखाने के लिए उपयोग किया गया है कि बड़ा बच्चा अपने पिता जैसा है।) • **Example:** The elder child takes after his father. They look like siblings. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. after**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Up** (ऊपर): Used to indicate movement to a higher position or level. • **Example:** He climbed up the ladder to fix the roof. • **In** (भीतर): Indicates inclusion or location within something. • **Example:** She is in her room studying for the exams. • **Before** (पहले): Refers to a time earlier than another or in front of something. • **Example:** You should complete your homework before going out to play. 59:Tf28, सही उत्तर है: **विकल्प 3 यानी after**।
